checks: two noncooperative children plus supervisor/worker exhaust four process slots
every noncooperative load child has actual timer preemptions; baseline tasks remain live
real PS/2 focus and typed-command actions observed through strictly subsequent completed frame generations
qemu_profile: q35/TCG cpu=qemu64 smp=1 RAM=256MiB software framebuffer PS/2
scope: Host wall-clock QMP keyboard action/typed-command Enter to serial-observed completed software frame. Includes QEMU TCG, host scheduling, QMP/serial and instrumentation delays; not kernel IRQ latency, physical hardware certification or guaranteed display/vblank latency.
idle_definition: PID1 and its persistent worker remain active; idle means no added noncooperative console children.
phase_order_limit: Fixed same-run order; cache/warmup/drift effects are not isolated.
